item.title: ecCodes vs cfgrib vs MetPy in 2026: The Right Way to Decode GRIB2 Weather Data in Python
item.description: A single ERA5 pressure-level file is 400 MB. A GFS 0.25° forecast cycle is several gigabytes spread over dozens of files. And when you open the first one, Python hands you back a wall of undocumented integer codes, a longitude axis running from 0 to 360, and a KeyError for a parameter you were sure existed.
